**Associate Professor of Economics at [ITAM](http://cie.itam.mx/)** · Co-Editor at the *[Journal of Development Economics](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-development-economics)*

I was born and raised in Colombia, where I earned a B.A. in economics (summa cum laude) and a
B.A. in mathematics (cum laude) from [Universidad de los Andes](https://uniandes.edu.co). I
received my Ph.D. in economics from the
[University of California, San Diego](https://economics.ucsd.edu/).

I hold affiliations at the [Jameel Poverty Action Lab (J-PAL)](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/person/romero-0),
[Innovations for Poverty Action (IPA)](https://www.poverty-action.org/people/mauricio-romero),
[Experiments in Governance and Politics (EGAP)](https://egap.org/our-members/), the
[Center for Global Development (CGD)](https://www.cgdev.org/expert/mauricio-romero), the
[Bureau for Research and Economic Analysis of Development (BREAD)](https://www.ibread.org/about/people/),
and the [Institute for Labor Economics (IZA)](https://www.iza.org/person/33481/mauricio-romero).

I am a [Jacobs Foundation Research Fellow](https://jacobsfoundation.org/fellows/jacobs-foundation-research-fellowship-en/mauricio-romero/)
(2024–2026 cohort) and currently serve on the Executive Committee of
[LACEA](https://www.lacea.org/portal/) (2024–2027).

My work focuses on the bottlenecks that impede high-quality government provision of education,
health care, and environmental protection. In conjunction with my empirical research agenda, I
work on methodological issues in applied econometrics and statistics.
